# Inferus Server Rules
These rules apply on Inferus. Violating them may result in a warning, temporary ban, permanent ban, or role/job restrictions. When in doubt, use Admin Help.
Inferus is a [bold]roleplaying[/bold] server. We expect consideration, storytelling, and adult behavior. Admins can make mistakes and appeals exist, but low-effort chaos for its own sake is not welcome.
The server is [bold]18+[/bold]. Characters must also behave as adults. Inferus is ERP-[bold]friendly[/bold], not ERP-centric.
Remember, the rules and examples given here are NOT exhaustive. Admins have final say.
## Golden Rule The baseline expectation for every player on Inferus.
- [textlink="0. The Golden Rule" link="RuleI0"]
## Basic Rules These apply at all times, including between rounds.
- [textlink="1.1 Admins have final say" link="RuleI1-1"] - [textlink="1.2 Players and Characters must be and behave like the age of 18 and above" link="RuleI1-2"] - [textlink="1.3 Don't be an asshole" link="RuleI1-3"] - [textlink="1.4 “Metacomming” is a case by case basis" link="RuleI1-4"] - [textlink="1.5 Do not Rule Lawyer anyone" link="RuleI1-5"]
## Gameplay Standards Standards for how you play the round.
- [textlink="2.1 Safe Zones include Cryosleep, Atmos, Arrivals, and Dorms" link="RuleI2-1"] - [textlink="2.2 Roleplay as a believable character" link="RuleI2-2"] - [textlink="2.3 Metagaming and Metagrudging are FORBIDDEN" link="RuleI2-3"] - [textlink="2.4 Do Not abandon your roles" link="RuleI2-4"] - [textlink="2.5 Stick to your role" link="RuleI2-5"]
## Roleplaying Rules These apply during rounds.
- [textlink="3.1 Do not use familiar names" link="RuleI3-1"] - [textlink="3.2 Silicon/Positronics bound by law must follow those laws" link="RuleI3-2"] - [textlink="3.3 If you roll antag and don't want to play, ahelp to change" link="RuleI3-3"] - [textlink="3.4 Free agents and antagonistic ghost roles can be friendly" link="RuleI3-4"] - [textlink="3.5 If you are NOT an antagonist, do not behave as such" link="RuleI3-5"] - [textlink="3.6 Security are people too" link="RuleI3-6"] - [textlink="3.7 Metashields are non-existent here" link="RuleI3-7"] - [textlink="3.8 Suicide Roleplay is Convoluted" link="RuleI3-8"]
## Erotic Roleplay and Themes Inferus is ERP-friendly, not ERP-centric. Consent is mandatory, [bold]no matter what.[/bold]
- [textlink="4.1 We are ERP FRIENDLY, not ERP CENTRIC" link="RuleI4-1"] - [textlink="4.2 Public sex is allowed with subtle emotes" link="RuleI4-2"] - [textlink="4.3 Kinkshaming is prohibited" link="RuleI4-3"] - [textlink="4.4 Regarding extreme or triggering kinks…" link="RuleI4-4"] - [textlink="4.5 Do not abuse Safe Zones or 4.2" link="RuleI4-5"] - [textlink="4.6 Antagging and ERP" link="RuleI4-6"] - [textlink="4.7 Headsets for All" link="RuleI4-7"] - [textlink="4.8 Bestiality is ABSOLUTELY forbidden" link="RuleI4-8"]
## Command Standards Higher expectations for Command, Security, and Medical.
- [textlink="5.1 Command and Security are held at higher standards and more scrutiny" link="RuleI5-1"] - [textlink="5.2 Command, Security, and Medical are expected to be available for their department at all times" link="RuleI5-2"] - [textlink="5.3 Being demoted from your position may trigger an investigation by “Central Command.”" link="RuleI5-3"]
